title: Step Pyramid as methane fracking system

tellings.quote: So, you're using the external reservoir to manipulate the water level inside of the step pyramid to increase and decrease pressure within your fracking tunnels.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien told him what the pyramids were really for, explains on Jesse Michels' podcast his idea about the Step Pyramid at Saqqara in Egypt. He says it was a machine for drawing methane gas out of the ground by fracking, cracking rock with pressure, and that an outside water reservoir was used to raise and lower the water inside the pyramid to push pressure up and down in its tunnels. If true, the pyramid would be an industrial plant rather than a tomb.
